chapter_seo_title: Dao Gui Yi Xian Ch. 49: The Heart-Element – Li Huowang’s Escape & The Abbot’s Ritual
chapter_meta_description: Li Huowang flees Xijing in terror, planning a path through the wilderness. But at Zhengde Temple, Abbot Xin Hui performs a grotesque ritual and reveals why Li Huowang is so valuable: he is a rare ‘Heart-Element’.
og_title: The Heart-Element is a Death Sentence
og_description: As Li Huowang runs for his life, a temple abbot casually creates a vase-girl and orders the hunt for a rare human ingredient.
twitter_title: “Where did Danyangzi find such a rare Heart-Element?” – Abbot Xin Hui
twitter_description: Ch. 49: We finally learn why everyone wants Li Huowang. He’s not just a target; he’s a rare ingredient.
